name: Horseshoe
summary: Iron horseshoe with nail holes, lying on the ground; for stables, farms, blacksmith and good-luck scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line under the curve of the shoe

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 400 px wide (hero size); use about 0.2 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = the shoe turns around its centre; pop = springs up to full size once
